reports.summary: Lists all recipes in an 8-column table. The user can search by name, filter by category, sort by time, mark favorites and open a recipe.
mobileIssues: 8-column table is too wide for a phone screen
the category filter buttons take a whole row next to the search field
the ingredients tooltip appears on mouse hover over a row; phones have no hover
suggestedObligations: shows every recipe with its name, category, time, difficulty and rating ('Sarma', 'Glavna jela', '180 min', 'Teško', '4,9')
typing 'sarma' in 'Pretraga' shows only 'Sarma'; with no match it shows 'Nema recepata za zadatu pretragu'
tapping 'Deserti' shows only desserts ('Palačinke' visible, 'Sarma' hidden); 'Sve kategorije' shows all again
tapping 'Sortiraj po vremenu' orders recipes from the shortest time
tapping 'Dodaj u omiljene: Sarma' turns the button into 'Ukloni iz omiljenih: Sarma'

reports.summary: Shows one recipe: ingredients with amounts in one column and preparation steps in another, servings that scale the amounts, favorite and add-to-shopping-list buttons.
dataSources: shopping list in localStorage via src/store/shoppingList.ts
mobileIssues: ingredients and preparation steps are two columns side by side
suggestedObligations: '/recepti/4' shows 'Sarma', 'Mleveno meso: 1000 g' and '520 kcal po porciji'
'Povećaj porcije' changes 'Porcije: 8' to 'Porcije: 9' and 'Mleveno meso: 1125 g'
tapping 'Dodaj sastojke u listu za kupovinu' shows 'Sastojci su dodati u listu za kupovinu'
an unknown id ('/recepti/999') shows 'Recept nije pronađen'

reports.summary: A list of categories next to the recipes of the chosen category (master–detail).
mobileIssues: the category list and the recipes are side by side
suggestedObligations: before a choice the screen shows 'Izaberite kategoriju'
tapping 'Supe' shows 'Pileća supa' and no recipes of other categories ('Sarma')
tapping a recipe name opens its detail screen

reports.summary: A three-column card grid with the recipes marked as favorites.
mobileIssues: three cards side by side do not fit a phone screen
suggestedObligations: with no favorites the screen shows 'Nemate omiljenih recepata'
recipes marked as favorites are listed by name
tapping 'Ukloni iz omiljenih: Sarma' removes 'Sarma' from the screen

reports.summary: A form to add items and a table of items with a bought checkbox, a counter and a button to clear bought items.
dataSources: shopping list in localStorage via src/store/shoppingList.ts
mobileIssues: the items are an HTML table
the list is stored in localStorage
suggestedObligations: with no items the screen shows 'Lista za kupovinu je prazna'
filling 'Namirnica' with 'Hleb' and tapping 'Dodaj' adds 'Hleb' and shows 'Kupljeno: 0 od 1'
checking an item updates the counter to 'Kupljeno: 1 od 1'
tapping 'Obriši kupljene' removes checked items and keeps the others
